records.text: Anonymous CBS town hall audience sources told Owens that questions were pre-submitted and that some segments required multiple takes because Bari Weiss wanted to read a teleprompter
records.speaker: CBS town hall audience sources (identities unverified)

appearances.snippet: I have sources just everywhere, CBS News, the people that were in the audience I showed you were emailing me and they had to do multiple takes because Bari (Bari Weiss) wanted to read a prompter. These questions were pre-submitted

verification.notes: The event, moderator, pre-recording, and invited/selected audience are independently supported by AP, CBS, and the attendee solicitation reported by the Guardian. The stronger claims that questions were pre-submitted and that multiple takes were required rest on unnamed audience sources relayed by Owens; no authoritative production record located confirms those details. The statement now separates the supported logistics from the unverified sourcing claim.
